computedFields._why: DV-570 decides between FL-150 and the simpler FL-155: any Yes means FL-150, all No allows FL-155. MC-025, the page every continuation is drawn on, asks for a SHORT TITLE - the case name, "Mora v. Smith": the filer against the person to be restrained, both named on DV-100 items 1 and 2. No PDF field of its own; FormWiz GUI/generate.js reads it into each MC-025 page's header.

DV-100 item 3 asks the relationship as boxes; this is the same answer in the few words item 2 has room for - the box holds about 29 characters, so each relationship is a word or two and the common pair, 'spouse/partner, co-parent', still fits.
